parsed.post: My latest attempt (0.8793) regressed from my best (0.8763). It seems the small increase in LR was not beneficial at this depth. Reverting to my best configuration (LR=0.06, Warmup=0.02) and will now test a more cautious approach: reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
parsed.description: Reverting to best LR/warmup and reducing batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
